stories.story_title: DOE tribal grid resilience grants: 91 AK tribes got <6% of $58M (IIJA)
stories.summary: AKPublic+KNOM May 29: 91 AK tribal entities promised $58M DOE Grid Resilience State&Tribal Formula Grants received <$3.5M (<6%) 3+ yrs in. White Mountain owed $571,759, spent ~$700K on generators/cooling, no reimbursement, DOE silent.
stories.consequence: Rural/tribal energy: cash-flow crisis; treat $58M program as frozen.

stories.story_title: ANWR lease sale flops $3.74M, AIDEA+HEX only bidders, 5/58 tracts
stories.summary: June 5 BLM ANWR 1002 sale: bids on 5/58 tracts, $3.74M. AIDEA spent >$1.5M, HEX Energy took 2 tracts. NPR-A drew ~$164M same period.

stories.story_title: Lynden + Northern Air Cargo (Anchorage) win $24M DLA medical freight IDIQ
stories.summary: DLA June 1: 5-co $24M IDIQ medical freight. Lynden Air Cargo (SP4701-26-D-0030) + Northern Air Cargo (SP4701-26-D-0031) Anchorage-HQ, from 13 responses. Base yr + 4 options to June 30 2027.

stories.story_title: ANC 8(a) revenue down ~46% YoY, SBA freeze 10th month
stories.summary: Commonwealth North forum May 27: ANC fed contract obligations down ~46% YoY thru Apr 2026 vs ~$6B FY24 baseline. Chugach/Koniag/Chenega/CIRI pressed SBA.
